void.$description: Void — Page background, canvas — the absolute base on which all other elements float

ash.$description: Ash — Body and link text, default copy tone on the black canvas — chosen over pure white to soften optical glare

frost.$description: Frost — Display headings, button text, input field text and rules — the brightest tier, reserved for content that must lead

graphite.$description: Graphite — Copyright, meta, tertiary helper text — deliberately muted so it never competes with the body tier

crimson-signal.$description: Crimson Signal — Primary action fill — the single red accent; appears on the Contact Us pill, in the brand logo mark, and nowhere else. Its rarity is the design

sui.$description: The sole typeface. Sui is a custom geometric sans used for everything from 198px display down to 10px caption. Weight 700 is reserved for monumental display and large headings; weight 400 carries the rest of the system. The bold/regular contrast is the type system — no second family is needed.
